instruction: Extract from Invoices/Ana Ruiz - hours.pdf the billed work dates, hours/times per day for Nov 2-8, and any hourly rate printed. Schema: date, start, end, billed duration, hourly rate.
List cameras (ug-surveillance cameras) and identify the Front Door camera id and timezone.

ug-document extract: file "Invoices/Ana Ruiz - hours.pdf"; query "work dates with start time, end time and billed hours per day, and the hourly rate if printed"; schema: rows of {date, start, end, billed_hours}, hourly_rate
ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known: list registered known faces.

ug-surveillance event-timeline: location "Front Door" camera, start-time 2026-11-02T00:00:00, end-time 2026-11-08T23:59:59, timezone America/New_York, topic HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name "Ana Ruiz", limit 200.
